proves.claim: records in a registry-<id>.json beside journeys count toward cli.stable.complete the same as records in the fixtures folder.

cli.stable.journey-local-registries.why: Without it a lane that may not edit the core-owned fixtures folder cannot register its tests and its gate goes red on cli.stable.complete.

proves.claim: a test id recorded both beside a journey and in the fixtures folder is still refused as a duplicate.

cli.stable.journey-local-duplicate-id.why: Without it a journey-local record could silently shadow a fixtures record and break unique ids.
